newsitem.title: CHINA: Jinan Qingqi opens up 21.99 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jinan Qingqi opens up 21.99 percent.

text.p: Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle Co's 230 million B shares debuted on the Shanghai stock exchange on Tuesday at $0.588, up 21.99 percent against an issue price of $0.482.
Brokers said it was the first B share issue this year on the Shanghai B share market and the listing had attracted heavy buying.
In addition, the company posted solid net profits last year and its prospects in the next couple of years are good, making the shares attractive, the brokers said.
"The opening price was relatively low compared with the company's good results," said one trader.
"The shares have the potential to rise further for the rest of the session today with its price possibly hitting $0.65 at the close," a second trader said.
A few minutes after trading, the stock rose to $0.626.
The company reported a net profit according to international accounting standards of 256.392 million yuan for 1996 against 126.435 million yuan for 1995.
In its listing statement last week, the company forecast a net profit of 408.424 million yuan for 1997. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
